description: Abdul Lathif Mohamed Ali & 9 Others v. O.I.C., Mannar Police Station & Others Abdul Lathif Mohamed Ali & 9 Others v. O.I.C., Mannar Police Station & Others View More before Hon. P.R. Walgama, J
parties: Abdul Lathif Mohamed Ali & 9 Others v. O.I.C., Mannar Police Station & Others Abdul Lathif Mohamed Ali & 9 Others v. O.I.C., Mannar Police Station & Others View More
keywords: Provincial High Court appeal – Primary Court land dispute – Likelihood of breach of peace – Competing claims of title – Magistrate placing 2nd party respondent in possession – Revision dismissed by High Court – Primary Court proceedings intended to preserve peace rather than finally determine title – Status quo – Parties entitled to vindicate title in District Court – Failure to join necessary parties in appeal – Necessary-party objection – Parallel District Court proceedings – Appeal becoming academic – Grounds of appeal devoid of merit – Appeal dismissed without costs.
legistation: Primary Courts’ Procedure Act No. 44 of 1979 – sections 66(1) and 69(1); Civil Procedure Code – section 168. The judgment also discusses section 62 of the Administration of Justice Law through precedent.
